name: All Embed – Multi-Source Embed Widgets for Elementor
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
All Embed Addon for Elementor enhances your Elementor experience by allowing you to embed content from multiple platforms directly into your pages. Each widget is designed to be user-friendly, fully customizable, and responsive.
Support | Demo
Features include:
– Seamless integration with Elementor.
– Widgets for video, audio, social media, and interactive content.
– Fully responsive embeds for all screen sizes.
– Supports over 25 popular platforms.

Available Widgets:
1. YouTube Embed: Add YouTube videos to your pages with ease.
2. Vimeo Embed: Showcase high-quality Vimeo videos.
3. SoundCloud Embed: Embed audio tracks from SoundCloud.
4. InVision Embed: Display interactive prototypes from InVision.
5. JotForm Embed: Add forms created with JotForm.
6. Google Maps Embed: Integrate interactive Google Maps.
7. Appointly Embed: Schedule and manage appointments.
8. Spotify Embed: Showcase music, albums, or podcasts from Spotify.
9. Giphy Embed: Add fun and engaging GIFs from Giphy.
10. Imgur Embed: Share images from Imgur.
11. SlideShare Embed: Present slides from SlideShare.
12. CodePen Embed: Showcase interactive code snippets.
13. Twitch Embed: Stream live or recorded Twitch videos.
14. TwitFrame Embed: Embed Twitter content dynamically.
15. Bandcamp Embed: Share music from Bandcamp.
16. Dailymotion Embed: Embed Dailymotion videos.
17. Dartfish Embed: Share Dartfish sports videos.
18. Genially Embed: Add interactive visual content from Genially.
19. Sirv Embed: Showcase images with interactive zoom features.
20. Mixcloud Embed: Embed audio mixes from Mixcloud.
21. Kuula Embed: Share 360° images and VR content.
22. Facebook Embed: Add Facebook posts, pages, or videos.
23. Pinterest Embed: Share boards, pins, or profiles.
24. LinkedIn Embed: Showcase LinkedIn posts or profiles.
25. Reddit Embed: Embed posts and discussions from Reddit.

Usage

sections.installation:
Download the latest version of All Embed Addons For Elementor (.zip file)
In your Admin, go to menu Plugins > Add New
Select “Upload Plugin”
After Install The Plugin, Just Active It And Use it Smoothly

Note: This plugin works with Elementor. Make sure you have Elementor installed.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.

  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
What platforms does All Embed Addons for Elementor support?

We support over 25+ platforms including YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify, SoundCloud, Google Maps, Facebook, Twitter, Twitch, Dailymotion, Reddit, and many more. It is the ultimate Elementor embed solution for any content type.

How do I embed a YouTube video in Elementor?

Simply search for the YouTube widget in the Elementor panel, drag it to your page, and paste your video URL. You can also customize settings like autoplay, mute, and loop directly from the editor.

Can I embed audio files like Spotify or SoundCloud?

Yes! We have specific widgets for Spotify, SoundCloud, Mixcloud, and Bandcamp. These allow you to embed songs, playlists, and podcasts directly into your Elementor pages with a native look and feel.

Is this plugin compatible with the free version of Elementor?

Absolutely. All Embed Addons works perfectly with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro. You do not need the Pro version of Elementor to use our widgets.

How do I embed social media posts from Facebook or Twitter?

We provide dedicated widgets for Facebook and Twitframe (Twitter). You can easily embed public posts, feeds, timelines, and tweets to increase your social engagement.

Does it support business tools like Google Maps or Jotform?

Yes, it is excellent for business websites. You can easily embed Google Maps for your office location and Jotform for contact forms, surveys, or booking forms.

Is the embedded content responsive?

Yes, all embeds are designed to be fully responsive. They will automatically adjust to fit the screen size of mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers, ensuring a great user experience.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No coding is required at all. This is a beginner-friendly Elementor addon designed for easy drag-and-drop usage. If you can use Elementor, you can use this plugin.
